speaker: Doctor
text: I see you have a longstanding pruritic rash along with numbness and tingling in your palms. To understand the underlying cause, have you noticed any specific changes in your skin color, such as whitening or reddening, when you expose your hands to cold temperatures?

speaker: Patient
text: 50-year-old male. The patient reports a year-long history of an itchy rash on his upper body and face. Additionally, he has been experiencing a numbness and tingling sensation on both palms. He has been working on his family's rice farm, also caring for livestock.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Poison Ivy Dermatitis (Rhus Dermatitis)

The patient's description of a one-year history of an itchy rash on the upper body and face, combined with work on a rice farm and care of livestock, is highly suggestive of chronic allergic contact dermatitis from poison ivy exposure. The numbness and tingling in the palms may be due to concurrent exposure to other irritants or a separate neuropathy unrelated to the skin rash. Can you confirm if the rash appears in linear streaks or clusters, and whether you have noticed any blistering or weeping?
